detail: One-time corrective rebuild: replaced dd.json/td.json/install.json entirely using an authoritative full-YTD ServiceTitan Job Detail export (Jan 2 - Sep 9) provided directly by the user, after discovering the prior historical data (predating the Aug 18 daily-email automation) was missing roughly $2.3M of Install-category revenue. New totals reconcile exactly to ServiceTitan's own Completed Revenue KPI for the same range ($9,550,058.48). Going forward the normal daily sync/daily_sync.js continues to upsert on top of this corrected baseline.
